overview_description: List, create, read, update and delete the child organisations below the root organisation of your Exsited instance.
intro: Child organisations are the organisations below the root organisation of your Exsited instance. You can list, create, read, update and delete them. This area has 5 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
warning: **Creating a child organisation changes your organisation hierarchy and assigns an existing user to it.** The create also depends on your licence. Reading, creating, updating and deleting one child organisation have not been confirmed, and the fields a child organisation takes are not documented yet.
notes: **Bodies and records sit under `organization`, spelled with a z.**
**The root organisation is never in the listing.** Read it with `GET /settings/organisation` instead.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records sit under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` to read the next page, and stop when `pagination.has_more` is `false`.

endpoints.title: List child organisations
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of the child organisations on your instance; the root is never included.
endpoints.description: Records are under `data`, and the listing pages by cursor. The root organisation is not in this list; read it with `GET /settings/organisation`. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of records per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` from the previous page, to read the next page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by; prefix it with `-` for descending order.

200.description: One page of child organisations, under `data`, with `pagination`.

endpoints.title: Create a child organisation
endpoints.summary: Creates a child organisation and returns it under `organization`.
endpoints.description: Send the organisation under `organization`, spelled with a z. A create depends on your licence, changes the organisation hierarchy and assigns an existing user. A successful call returns `201`. The fields a child organisation takes are not documented yet.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a child organisation
endpoints.summary: Returns one child organisation by its `id`.
endpoints.description: Pass the organisation's `id` as `organisation_id`. The response is the organisation's fields, with no wrapper key.

parameters.name: organisation_id
parameters.description: The child organisation's `id`, from the listing.

endpoints.title: Delete a child organisation
endpoints.summary: Deletes a child organisation and returns no body.
endpoints.description: Pass the organisation's `id` as `organisation_id`. A successful call returns `204`.

parameters.name: organisation_id
parameters.description: The child organisation's `id`, from the listing.

204.description: The child organisation is deleted. No body.

endpoints.title: Update a child organisation
endpoints.summary: Changes a child organisation's fields and returns it.
endpoints.description: Pass the organisation's `id` as `organisation_id` and send the fields to change under `organization`. A successful call returns `200`. The fields a child organisation takes are not documented yet.

parameters.name: organisation_id
parameters.description: The child organisation's `id`, from the listing.
